title: {session}-subtask-plan-{task_id}.json
description: Step 8.2 B0.7 scout output. Read-only decomposition of ONE step-8 goal into a sub-task DAG. The scout can only ADD splits; indivisible:true dispatches the goal whole. The estimate is advisory and never gates dispatch (Open risk 1). See apex-core.md step 8.2 / agents/scout.md.

subtasks.description: Independent (or depends_on-chained) atomic sub-units of the goal. Empty iff indivisible:true.

label.description: <=6-term key-term label (lowercase, stopwords + <4-char tokens dropped); becomes the spawned executor's goal.

files.description: Repo-relative paths this sub-task writes. MUST be a subset of the goal's resolved per-task allowed_files - the scout can only partition, never widen scope.

depends_on.description: Indices into this subtasks[] array that must complete before this sub-task dispatches. Empty -> independent (parallel via run_in_background). Non-empty -> serialized after the referenced sub-tasks.

indivisible.description: True -> the goal is one atomic unit; dispatch it whole as today (subtasks empty).

reason.description: One-line justification for the partition (or for indivisibility).

estimate.description: Advisory only - NEVER gate dispatch on these numbers (Open risk 1: LLMs estimate cost poorly). The DAG is the deliverable.
